note:
Richard Birkin, justice of the peace for Nottinghamshire, at 7 Newcastle Drive (#211) on the 1891 return with five servants and no family on the schedule, transcribed by A. Hagues. None of the six was in the record, and 7 Newcastle Drive held only 1921 (the Cartwrights, moved along from number 1), so 1891 is free.

**The surname is entered as Birkin, not Berkin.** The transcription reads Berkin, which is an index rendering: the man is a justice of the peace born at New Basford, and Wright's Directory prints 'Mr. William Henry Acourt Birkin' at this same number 7 in 1898-99, so the house was a Birkin house within seven years of this return. His stated office, 'justice of peace for Nottingham shore', is the schedule reaching for Nottinghamshire.

**He is not the Richard Birkin already in the record.** #2861 is Richard Leslie Birkin of Edale House, Clumber Road East, whom the directory styles Lieut.-Col. R. L. Birkin J.P., D.S.O. from 1910-11 - a later man of the same family, not this 62-year-old of 1891. Nothing binds them, and no family link is made to any of the Park's other Birkins: Charles Wilfred at Newcastle Court and Elm House, Philip Austen at 5 Cavendish Crescent North, Harry Laurence at Lincoln House, or the Thomas Isaac Birkin firm. The connections are very likely real and are worth tracing, but a shared surname in a lace dynasty is not evidence of a particular relationship.

He is returned as married with his wife absent from the schedule. Five servants for one man - housekeeper, cook, housemaid, kitchen maid and general servant - is a large establishment and fits a family house being kept up. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way. **The number is confirmed by the schedule itself.** A. Hagues has since supplied the page: schedules 84 to 88 are headed 13, 11, 9, 7 and 5 **Newcastle drive** in the enumerator's own hand. Although this street had been Pelham Terrace, the 1891 numbers on it are Newcastle Drive numbers. See [[newcastle-drive-pelham-terrace-numbers]].
source: 1891 census, 7 Newcastle Drive, transcribed by A. Hagues (surname transcribed Berkin). Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1898-99, page 109 (Leicester Special Collections id 165285).
